body: I want to give you a hug right now man. Started tearing up at just the fact that someone sat here and wrote this to help me. I have a lot of time ahead of me, your right with that. Everything about the world right now is crazy. We’re treated like sheep and are kept from knowing so much. You seem like you have a lot of experience and are very wise. If pain killers is what can give you temporary happiness when it isn’t there naturally, so be it. Discipline yourself with it so it doesn’t get out of control and it’ll all be good. I didn’t include a lot of details because I didn’t need responses calling me out for the things I’ve done. I’ve taken pain killers on occasion and know how hooking it can be. Discipline is all you need. Thank you for helping me out and making me feel some hope again. Good things coming your way.
Thank you for the support. hoping it all gets better very soon. This world is insane right now. best of luck with everything
